chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Suleiman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said regarding a free man who dies and has a slave mother: 'She should be bought from her son's wealth, then emancipated, then she inherits.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to a slave mother when her free son dies according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi details the specific legal procedure for manumitting a slave mother upon her free son's death, ensuring her freedom is secured from his estate before final distribution. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic emphasis on honoring the mother's status and securing her liberty as a priority claim against the deceased's assets, reflecting the broader ethical imperative of filial piety in inheritance law.
